materialAlerts.headline: ESPN sources: Colts open to trading Jonathan Taylor; multiple clubs in active talks
materialAlerts.claim: Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport report Indianapolis is open to trading Jonathan Taylor and that talks are active with multiple clubs; reported interest includes Denver, Green Bay, Minnesota, New York Giants and Seattle. This is sourced reporting, not a completed trade, an agreed destination or an official club transaction.
